sn22.5:1.4: Mendicants are similarly enjoined to develop immersion in order to understand the six senses ([sn35.99](), [sn35.160]()) and the four noble truths ([sn56.1]()).
sn22.5:3.3: “Relishing” (_nandī_) is a synonym of “craving” (_taṇhā_). Here it serves to connect the five aggregates with dependent origination.
